record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare FIRE_FANG: Growlithe (1 star) and Arcanine (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 1 and no passive (catalog NONE). The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: Direct registry entry with a dedicated file; no routing uncertainty was queued. Hisuian Growlithe/Arcanine are separate units not covered here.

record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage on the cast target, raw 30/60/120/240 by caster stars (Growlithe 30, Arcanine 60), AP-scaled, followed by a 2000 ms burn on the same target (origin = caster). Crit applies only with ability crit. No movement.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table value by caster stars. AP: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost true, passed explicitly); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: Requested = raw table value; applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, minimum 1) in handleDamage; shields and takenDamage are resolved in handleDamage and not read by this strategy (return value unused). Blocked completely if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce.

effects.scaling: Requested duration 2000 ms, not AP-scaled. Applied duration = 2000 after the target's duration reductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone x(1-0.1 per stone)); it replaces the burn timer and origin only if longer than the remaining burn time. Not applied with IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect or the WATER_BUBBLE passive.
effects.resolution: While burning the target takes TRUE damage each 1000 ms tick equal to round(5% of its max HP) with weather / item / effect multipliers (Drought x1.3 less Heat Rock, Rain x0.7, Assault Vest x0.5, duration-reduction effects as above); no tick damage with the Well Baked passive or Magmarizer. The burn is applied after the damage call and even when that damage was blocked; side effects on the burned unit (Guts, Well Baked, Magmarizer, Rawst Berry) are listed in the evidence note.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 120 and 240 (fallback) entries are not reachable by these two units' star counts. Burn duration does not depend on stars. maxPP 80 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Recasting on a burning target only extends the burn if the new 2000 ms (after reductions) exceeds the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Raw: damage 30/60, burn 2000 ms. Requested = raw; applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1). Applied burn = 2000 after target-side reductions or none (immunity / Rune Protect / Water Bubble); the burn tick damage is a separate TRUE-damage stream not part of the cast damage. takenDamage is not read here.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Whether other code reacts to a target being burnt (synergies, items) beyond Status.triggerBurn / updateBurn
unresolved: How the target is chosen before the cast was not read.
